scope: Read-only local sources and bounded most-recent PostgreSQL samples. No new network collection; no strategy/config/process mutations.

findings.title: 历史K线订单流不是挂单
findings.evidence: fetch_orderflow.py:86-109 retains taker buy volume and quote, trade count; it has no bids/asks. OI fetch uses sumOpenInterest.
findings.implication: taker_buy measures executed aggressive trades. OI measures outstanding derivatives contracts, not pending unfilled orders. Do not use these as order-wall size.

findings.title: 旧快照只有一轮且陈旧
findings.evidence: orderbook_snapshots.jsonl has 10 symbols x one record; last timestamp Beijing 2026-10-08 23:42:42. live_exec_monitor.py:76-93 aggregates 20 levels and discards levels; daemon default is 900s.
findings.implication: Cannot compute OFI, cancellation/replenishment, queue persistence or forward price response from old snapshot file. Current monitor is not running.

findings.title: 当前流可用但持仓覆盖为零
findings.evidence: market_stream.py:117-122 uses BTC/ETH aggregate trades and depth20@100ms. stream_stats currently contains only these pairs; all eight held symbols differ.
findings.implication: Prioritize actual held/candidate symbols before interpreting execution risk. BTC/ETH liquidity observations cannot be generalized to altcoins.

findings.title: 20档不等于固定距离深度
findings.evidence: Latest samples visible ranges are substantially below 1bp.
findings.implication: For 0.5/1/2/5/10bp measures, persist coverage flags per side. Uncovered bands are visible-depth lower bounds. Larger relevant bands require a wider synchronized book; no zero fill or extrapolation.

findings.title: 撤单与补单只能近似
findings.evidence: Partial snapshots + aggTrade; no order IDs, order-level add/cancel feed or authenticated open-order events.
findings.implication: Net volume disappearance may be trades, cancellations, movement beyond top20 or a missed event. Use net-depth-change / cancel_proxy with coverage and gap flags; no exact spoofing or causal support claims.

findings.title: 冲击公式未按档位和方向计算
findings.evidence: live_exec_monitor.py:107 uses min(bid_depth,ask_depth); 110 clips order/depth to 1; 112 uses half-spread plus 2*ratio*spread; 191 fixes 337USDT.
findings.implication: Replace research estimate with side-specific price-level sweep at actual order notional (margin*leverage or order quantity*price). Insufficient visible volume must be unknown, not capped cost. Do not label dry_run simulations as realized execution.

findings.title: 时钟和重连需进入样本有效性
findings.evidence: status reports data_gap_possible=true and 114 reconnects. Latest book receive-minus-exchange timestamp approximately -126ms while ticks approximately +17ms.
findings.implication: Preserve exchange E/T, local received and capture sequence. Use local availability time for shadow decisions, avoid mixing exchange and host clocks; diagnose clock offset before interpreting latency. Skip/reset feature windows across gaps.

findings.title: 执行质量管道没有测到真实滑点
findings.evidence: live_exec_monitor.py:151-175 docstring promises comparison but code only copies trade fields and returns counts. flow feather cache skips any existing file at155-159; OI fetch days unused and limit500.
findings.implication: No evidence yet of order-book-based execution improvement. OI 5m sample covers about41.6h, not30d; existing files do not incrementally update.

experiment.purpose: 事前量化挂单/订单流对短期价格变化与本策略执行成本的可观察增量，不重新扩大历史模型搜索。
experiment.stage_1: First 24h judge only timestamp/coverage/completeness. Reuse existing streams and bounded batches; expand held/candidate collection separately if authorized by parent scope. No live order changes.
experiment.cadence: Derive bounded 1-second feature rows from incoming snapshots/trades; retain raw source IDs. Never scan all data every tick.
freeze_features: depth USDT within 0.5/1/2/5bp, per-side full_coverage flag, visible_span_bp
1s/10s L1 OFI from changes of best quote price and queue quantity; explicitly sampled OFI
same-price visible depletion/replenishment and wall persistence; label cancellation inference as proxy
actual order side,margin,leverage,quantity,notional; size-aware sweep at both open and exit sides
experiment.l1_ofi_formula: e_n=I(pb_n>=pb_prev)*qb_n-I(pb_n<=pb_prev)*qb_prev-I(pa_n<=pa_prev)*qa_n+I(pa_n>=pa_prev)*qa_prev. Sum e over frozen window; normalize using only prior visible depth.
experiment.forward_labels: Append realized future mid returns and adverse move at +5s/+30s/+300s using availability timestamps and gap-valid samples. Never backfill a missing feature.
experiment.execution_shadow: At each real candidate, quote both baseline and frozen liquidity-guard shadow on identical candidate, notional, cash/slot and execution schedule. For rejected shadow orders keep cash, report missed follow-through separately. Report theoretical sweep and actual/dry_run fill as separate measures.
metrics: book coverage %, stale/gap reject %, number of valid independent time blocks
p50/p95 static execution cost by size and side; cases not fully covered=unknown
same pair/time volatility/spread-conditioned signed price response vs past-only baseline
guarded vs baseline paired costs; rejected orders subsequent returns/opportunity cost
net economics include actual fee and funding when known; missing costs remain unknown
experiment.acceptance: No claimed gain before adequate prospective paired valid samples. Frozen rules and fixed calendar review; group uncertainty by calendar/time blocks, not independent100ms snapshots. Final dashboard must show an effect or state insufficient evidence.
experiment.risk_link: Use liquidity and gap flags to cap/reject proposed leveraged notional and to assess stop-exit size. A visible wall alone must never widen a stop or justify leverage.

BTC/USDT:USDT.sweep_limitation: Frozen-book theoretical quote only. Excludes fee, funding, replenishment/cancellation, latency, queue position and own impact. Not actual realized slippage.

ETH/USDT:USDT.sweep_limitation: Frozen-book theoretical quote only. Excludes fee, funding, replenishment/cancellation, latency, queue position and own impact. Not actual realized slippage.

coverage_intersection.note: At audit time depth stream BTC/ETH does not overlap eight open positions.

definitions.resting_orders: Public visible bids/asks: unfilled price-level quantities, cancelable at any time.
definitions.open_interest: Outstanding futures/perpetual contracts; one matched contract has both long and short, OI is not bid/ask pending volume.
definitions.aggressive_flow: Executed trade volume, signed buy if buyer_maker=false and sell if buyer_maker=true.
